# Daily Briefing – Thursday 20 August

Yesterday was a rest day with decent movement at 7,456 steps, but that sleep is the real story — just 3.6 hours is seriously short, and your body knows it. Your HRV dropped to 80ms against your 100-118ms baseline, which is a clear signal that recovery is incomplete despite a relatively calm stress score of 39.

With HRV that suppressed, today isn't the day to push hard. If a run is planned, keep it easy — conversational pace only, 30-40 minutes maximum. Anything intense will dig a deeper hole than it fills.

Tonight, make sleep your absolute priority — it's genuinely your best performance tool right now. On nutrition, hit that 175g protein today regardless of appetite; it supports tissue repair even on low-output days. 2,300 calories is appropriate — don't undereat just because yesterday was quiet.
